intraday_rationale: EURUSD is currently pushing near session highs at 1.0948 with an active winning position already open. However, current 15m candles show a lack of high-volume displacement or a clean pullback structure to add risk. It is prudent to let the existing position run towards its target rather than forcing a new entry without a structural pullback.
learning_applied: Past stop-loss failure on XAUUSD taught us to avoid tight, micro-noise stops and wait for clear structural levels. Since no optimal structural stop is currently formed for a fresh EURUSD entry, remaining patient protects our capital.
